notes: With a plain GROUP BY, every emitted group holds at least one row, and `m.amount` is NOT NULL -- so SUM over the group cannot be NULL. This is the case that separates 'aggregates are nullable' from 'aggregates are nullable when their input is or their input may be empty'.
